function fmtNum(v, prefix, suffix) { const n = N(v); const p = prefix || ""; const s = suffix || ""; if (n >= 1e6) return p + (n / 1e6).toFixed(2) + "M" + s; if (n >= 1e3) return p + (n / 1e3).toFixed(1) + "K" + s; return p + n.toLocaleString() + s; }
function fmtShort(v) { const n = N(v); if (n >= 1e6) return (n / 1e6).toFixed(1) + "M"; if (n >= 1e3) return (n / 1e3).toFixed(0) + "K"; return n.toLocaleString(); }
function shortName(s) { if (!s) return ""; return s.split(" ")[0]; }
function hexToRgb(hex) { const h = hex.replace("#", ""); return { r: parseInt(h.substring(0, 2), 16), g: parseInt(h.substring(2, 4), 16), b: parseInt(h.substring(4, 6), 16) }; }
function interpolateColor(c1, c2, f) { const a = hexToRgb(c1), b = hexToRgb(c2); return `rgb(${Math.round(a.r+(b.r-a.r)*f)},${Math.round(a.g+(b.g-a.g)*f)},${Math.round(a.b+(b.b-a.b)*f)})`; }

function SkeletonBlock({ height, theme }) { return <div style={{ height: height || 160, background: theme.colors.muted + "15", borderRadius: 8, animation: "pulse 1.5s ease-in-out infinite" }} />; }

  return (
    <div style={{ fontFamily: theme.font, background: theme.colors.bg, color: theme.colors.text, minHeight: "100vh", padding: 20, transition: "background 0.3s, color 0.3s" }}>
      <style>{`@keyframes pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.5; } }`}</style>
      <div style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
        <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 8, marginBottom: 8 }}>
          <Coffee size={20} style={{ color: theme.colors.chart[0] }} />
          <span style={{ fontSize: 18, fontWeight: theme.title.weight, textTransform: theme.title.transform, letterSpacing: 0.5 }}>Galactic Coffee Co. — Theme Gallery</span>
        </div>
        <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 12, flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
          <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 4 }}>
            <button onClick={prevTheme} style={{ background: "none", border: "1px solid "+theme.colors.muted+"44", borderRadius: 4, color: theme.colors.text, cursor: "pointer", padding: "4px 6px", display: "flex", alignItems: "center" }}><ChevronLeft size={14} /></button>
            <span style={{ fontSize: 14, fontWeight: 600, minWidth: 140, textAlign: "center" }}>{theme.name}</span>
            <button onClick={nextTheme} style={{ background: "none", border: "1px solid "+theme.colors.muted+"44", borderRadius: 4, color: theme.colors.text, cursor: "pointer", padding: "4px 6px", display: "flex", alignItems: "center" }}><ChevronRight size={14} /></button>
          </div>
          <span style={{ fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 600, padding: "2px 8px", borderRadius: 10, background: (categoryColors[theme.category]||"#888")+"22", color: categoryColors[theme.category]||"#888", textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: 0.5 }}>{theme.category}</span>
          <span style={{ fontSize: 11, color: theme.colors.muted }}>{themeIdx+1}/{THEME_IDS.length}</span>
        </div>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 10, color: theme.colors.muted, marginTop: 6 }}>{theme.prompt.split("
").find(l => l.includes("Inspired by"))?.replace("Inspired by: ", "Inspired by: ") || ""}</div>
      </div>
      <div style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
        {summaryQ.isLoading ? <SkeletonKPI theme={theme} /> : (
          <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 24 }}>
            <div><div style={{ fontSize: 22, fontWeight: 700, color: theme.colors.chart[0] }}>{fmtNum(heroMetric, heroPrefix)}</div><div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: theme.colors.muted }}>{heroLabel}</div></div>
            <div><div style={{ fontSize: 22, fontWeight: 700, color: theme.colors.chart[1]||theme.colors.chart[0] }}>{fmtNum(metric==="cups_sold"?summaryData.revenue:summaryData.cups_sold, metric==="cups_sold"?"$":"")}</div><div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: theme.colors.muted }}>{metric==="cups_sold"?"Revenue":"Cups Sold"}</div></div>
            <div><div style={{ fontSize: 22, fontWeight: 700, color: theme.colors.chart[2]||theme.colors.chart[0] }}>{summaryData.avg_rating.toFixed(1)}</div><div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: theme.colors.muted }}>Avg Rating</div></div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
      <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 8, marginBottom: 8, flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
        <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 4 }}>{["2024","2025","All"].map(y => <button key={y} onClick={() => setYear(y)} style={pillStyle(year===y)}>{y}</button>)}</div>
        <div style={{ width: 1, height: 18, background: theme.colors.muted+"33" }} />
        <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 4 }}><button onClick={() => setMetric("revenue")} style={pillStyle(metric==="revenue")}>Revenue</button><button onClick={() => setMetric("cups_sold")} style={pillStyle(metric==="cups_sold")}>Cups</button></div>
      </div>
      {hasActiveFilters && <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 6, marginBottom: 10, flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
        {station !== "All" && <span onClick={() => setStation("All")} style={{ display: "inline-flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 4, background: theme.colors.chart[0]+"18", color: theme.colors.chart[0], border: "1px solid "+theme.colors.chart[0]+"44", borderRadius: 12, padding: "2px 10px", fontSize: 10, cursor: "pointer", fontFamily: theme.font }}>{shortName(station)} <X size={10} /></span>}
        {coffeeType !== "All" && <span onClick={() => setCoffeeType("All")} style={{ display: "inline-flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 4, background: (theme.colors.chart[1]||theme.colors.chart[0])+"18", color: theme.colors.chart[1]||theme.colors.chart[0], border: "1px solid "+(theme.colors.chart[1]||theme.colors.chart[0])+"44", borderRadius: 12, padding: "2px 10px", fontSize: 10, cursor: "pointer", fontFamily: theme.font }}>{coffeeType} <X size={10} /></span>}
      </div>}
      <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "repeat(3, 1fr)", gap: 10, marginBottom: 16 }}>
        {theme.charts.map((cc, idx) => <div key={idx} style={{ background: theme.colors.bg, border: "1px solid "+theme.colors.muted+"22", borderRadius: 8, padding: 8, overflow: "hidden" }}>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 10, fontWeight: theme.title.weight, textTransform: theme.title.transform, color: theme.colors.text, marginBottom: 4, letterSpacing: 0.3, whiteSpace: "nowrap", overflow: "hidden", textOverflow: "ellipsis" }}>{cc.title}</div>
          {isChartLoading(cc) ? <SkeletonBlock height={160} theme={theme} /> : renderChart(cc, theme, themeId, allData, interactivity)}
        </div>)}
      </div>
      <div style={{ background: theme.colors.muted+"0a", border: "1px solid "+theme.colors.muted+"22", borderRadius: 8, padding: 12, position: "relative" }}>
        <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center", marginBottom: 6 }}>
          <span style={{ fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 600, textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: 0.5, color: theme.colors.muted }}>Prompt</span>
          <button onClick={copyPrompt} style={{ background: "none", border: "1px solid "+theme.colors.muted+"44", borderRadius: 4, color: theme.colors.muted, cursor: "pointer", padding: "3px 8px", fontSize: 10, display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 4 }}>{copied ? <Check size={10} /> : <Copy size={10} />}{copied ? "Copied" : "Copy Prompt"}</button>
        </div>
        <pre style={{ fontSize: 10, lineHeight: 1.5, color: theme.colors.text, whiteSpace: "pre-wrap", wordBreak: "break-word", fontFamily: theme.font, margin: 0, opacity: 0.85 }}>{theme.prompt}</pre>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
